_note: ViewScale sweep point: the object-only recipe (18 small views per image, DINO loss on them only) with the 3 windows per image replaced by random SQUARE windows of extent 256 px in the 512-px frame (region_source fixed). Only run_name and fixed_extent_px differ between the sweep configs.

object_views._note: fixed_extent_px is the window extent e; object-global windows = e x obj_global_zoom (floor obj_global_size / max_magnification), object-local = e x obj_local_zoom
